theorems.name: Submission.lip_approx_graph_coordinates
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), (∀ (a a' : Rn n) (b b' : Rn ℓ), graphPoint a b - graphPoint a' b' = graphPoint (a - a') (b - b')) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), ‖graphPoint a b‖ ^ 2 = ‖a‖ ^ 2 + ‖b‖ ^ 2) ∧ (∀ z : Amb n ℓ, ∃ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), z = graphPoint a b) ∧ (∀ (a : Rn n) (b : Rn ℓ), (rotatedPlane q).starProjection (q (graphPoint a b)) = q (graphPoint a 0))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
